expected.reason: Lines 227-231: when the server has no configured `minecraftVersion` at all AND there's no latest-compatible hit, the item is reported upToDate rather than noCompatibleVersion -- the resolver can't distinguish 'nothing compatible with this unset version' from 'we don't know what version to check against', and picks the less-alarming label. Worth flagging: this can under-report a genuinely available update when a server's MC version simply isn't recorded.

notes: A server whose minecraftVersion field is unset will never surface noCompatibleVersion for any linked add-on, only upToDate or updateAvailable -- P8.16's port should preserve this exact fallback rather than treat it as a bug to silently fix.
